verdict: Salesforce grew revenue 10% to $10.2B as Data Cloud and AI recurring revenue passed $1.2B — up 120% — and a tenth straight quarter of margin expansion lifted net income 32% to $1.89B.

segments.name: Subscription and support
segments.note: The core software subscriptions — Sales, Service, Slack, Tableau, Agentforce and Data 360.

segments.name: Professional services and other
segments.note: Consulting and training that help customers roll the software out.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the platform — including Agentforce, Salesforce's AI agents, and Data 360 — up 10% YoY.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: The largest running cost — Salesforce's big sales force and marketing machine, up 7% YoY.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day — up 3% YoY.

opex.name: Restructuring
opex.note: One-off costs of reorganizing teams — down sharply from $99M a year ago.

follow100Note: Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: AI revenue is scaling
takeaways.text: Data Cloud and AI annual recurring revenue passed $1.2B, up 120% YoY. Salesforce has closed over 12,500 Agentforce deals since launch, more than 6,000 of them paid.

takeaways.title: Backlog keeps climbing
takeaways.text: Current remaining performance obligation — work customers have signed for and will pay for within a year — rose 11% to $29.4B. Future revenue is unusually visible.

takeaways.title: Margins kept expanding
takeaways.text: GAAP operating margin reached 22.8% — a tenth consecutive quarter of expansion — and net income rose 32% to $1.89B. Salesforce also added $20B to its buyback program.

otherDetail: A $6M gain on strategic investments (stakes Salesforce holds in other companies), plus $68M of other income, net — mostly interest earned, net of interest on Salesforce's debt.
